kind: matched summary; full per-step timings and trajectories are emitted by scripts/physics/matched/g8.mjs

notes: Native optimized Box3D versus browser WebGPU on the same host; this is not a WebAssembly comparison or a claim about multithreaded Box3D unless workers > 1.
Same SI inputs, outer timestep, substep count, masses, sharp boxes, zero damping and disabled sleeping. Solver algorithms/iteration controls differ; inspect quality alongside timing.

Timed replay excludes creation, rendering, diagnostics and state readbacks. GPU completion includes encoding, submission and a completion fence; GPU timestamps, when requested, come from a separate instrumented replay; primary timings have no timestamp queries.
Warmup advances the same scene; quality uses a fresh replay with periodic snapshots. Sampling cannot detect every transient contact error.
CPU bytes are Box3D allocated bytes; GPU bytes are logical graph buffers, not measured process RAM or VRAM residency. They are not directly equivalent.
Incomplete work, failed declared quality budgets, or software fallback never produces a hardware speed ratio. Budgets are a bounded comparison profile, not a general physics certification.

fixture.description: A close-packed cubic pile collapses into sustained shared contacts. Compare penetration, energy and full-step cost during collapse and settling. Shared Box3D/GPU inputs; this diagnostic view is not timed. Use the matched runner for independent quality and performance replays.

Eight-high stacks carry a 10:1 top load. Compare support drift and convergence under sustained load. Shared Box3D/GPU inputs; this diagnostic view is not timed. Use the matched runner for independent quality and performance replays.
Eight-high stacks expose solver drift and sustained contact error. Shared Box3D/GPU inputs; this diagnostic view is not timed. Use the matched runner for independent quality and performance replays.
